newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher reversing intital losses.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher reversing intital losses.

text.p: Madrid stocks turned around to end slightly higher on Friday after a weak start, with both indices setting new record closing highs.
Traders said selected buying supported prices, and added that the underlying trend remained positive despite some profit taking during Friday's session.
The general index rose 0.89 points, 0.15 pct, to 604.58, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares was up 4.91 points, or 0.07 percent, to 6,933.33. Turnover reached 99.15 billion pesetas.
Popular outpaced the market, ending 5.14 percent higher at 37,000 pesetas.
"The day was quiet, with demand focussing on Popular shares while the market was hit by profit taking," a dealer said.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica shed 40 pesetas to 4,335, and Repsol lost 30 pesetas to 6,260.
Endesa gained 70 pesetas to 12,170, while Iberdrola was unchanged at 1,890.
